caption: The drawing features a collection of decorative motifs arranged on a plain, light beige background. At the top center, there is a large triangular cluster composed of overlapping scalloped shapes, predominantly in blue and green hues, each containing a small circular flower-like detail inside. To the left and right of the top motif, there are identical oval shapes arranged in pairs, each pair linked together with pointed leaf-like elements radiating outward, also in shades of blue and green with fine line detailing. Below the central motif, near the middle of the composition, there is a single arched, band-like shape with paired leaves at each end, rendered in the same blue-green palette. Along the bottom left, there are three circular, flower-like forms aligned horizontally, each with concentric circles of petals colored in blue and green. On the bottom right, another band of three interconnected oval motifs, similar to the pairs above, is presented horizontally, linked and flanked by pointed leaves. The coloring and linework throughout the drawing use a consistent palette of blue, green, and subtle white detailing, with the shapes outlined in dark blue.
title: Decoration for Stoneware
